How it works

Three steps, all from your phone.

  1. Pick your dates

    Choose your arrival day and how many days you need, from 1 to 30. The price updates as you go.

  2. Pay online

    Enter your details and pay by card. You get a confirmation with your dates and registration.

  3. Park and go

    Park in the lot and walk two minutes to Luton station interchange for Luton Airport Parkway, or add our taxi to Luton Airport Parkway for £40 return.

Right by Luton station

The lot is in front of Luton town centre, a two-minute walk from Luton station interchange. From there, you can continue to Luton Airport Parkway.

Questions

Anything else, call or email us.

How many days can I book?

From one day up to 30 days online. For longer stays, contact us.

How is my price worked out?

We take the cheapest of the daily rate (£7), the weekly rate (£45) and the monthly rate (£120) for your stay. For example, 6 days costs £42, 7 days costs £45, 10 days costs £66, and any stay from 19 to 30 days costs £120.

Can I change or cancel my booking?

Yes. Cancel at least 24 hours before your booking starts and there is no charge. If you cancel less than 24 hours before, we keep 5% of the total you paid. Call or email us and quote your vehicle registration. See our terms below.

Can I arrive at night?

Yes. We are open 24/7. The gates are locked at night for security, so if you want to arrive or leave in the night, call us and we will open them.

What security do you have?

CCTV cameras run 24 hours a day, and a member of our team is at the car park during the daytime. The gates are locked at night.

How do I get to the airport?

Walk two minutes to Luton station interchange and continue to Luton Airport Parkway. Or add our taxi from the lot to Luton Airport Parkway, about a 10 minute drive, for £40 there and back.

Our car park

Photos of the lot in Luton, open 24/7.

Terms and conditions

Please read these before you book. By booking you agree to them.

Booking and payment

You can book from 1 to 30 days online. Your price is the cheapest combination of our daily (£7), weekly (£45) and monthly (£120) rates. Your booking is confirmed once your payment is received.

Cancellations

If you cancel at least 24 hours before your booking starts, there is no charge. If you cancel less than 24 hours before it starts, we keep 5% of the total amount you paid and refund the rest. To cancel, call or email us and quote your vehicle registration.

Opening hours and access

The car park is open 24/7. For security, the gates are closed and locked at night. If you need to arrive or leave during the night, including around midnight, call us and we will open the gates for you.

Security

CCTV cameras operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A member of our team is at the car park during the daytime.

Taxi to Luton Airport Parkway

The taxi is optional. It costs £40 in total for both journeys, from our car park to Luton Airport Parkway (about a 10 minute drive) and back. It is paid separately and is not charged online. Tell us when you book when you would like to be collected and brought back.
